VIEW DEFINITION:
 SELECT id,
    user_id,
    amount,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'paid'::text THEN 'approved'::text
            ELSE status
        END AS status,
    created_at,
    note
   FROM ervenow_withdraw_requests;

  amount numeric NULL
